mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user fires several slow homing Ki Blasts; if any shot connects, a rapid follow-up barrage activates, reaching 13 total hits in the current reference. Guarding cancels the barrage, allowing a transition to another action. Current documentation notes the full sequence can occupy roughly 3–4 seconds and reports low overall damage, but no exact damage value is treated as canonical here. Exact timing and damage values remain unresolved.
evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence only; unresolved numerical/frame details remain bounded.
